newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SCMB development fund grows by 186 mln rand.
newsitem.headline: SCMB development fund grows by 186 mln rand.

text.p: Standard Corporate and Merchant Bank Ltd (SCMB) said on Monday that five new investors had joined the South African Infrastructure Fund, increasing its size by 186 million rand.
The fund is now at an aggregate capital commitment of 693 million rand, SCMB said in a statement.

Investec Asset Management, Liberty Life Association of Africa Ltd, Post Office Pension Fund, South African Special Risks Insurance Association and Southern Life Association Ltd made up the new investors.
"With these capital commitments, the fund is the largest and most widely representative equity pool available for investment in infrastructure projects in Africa," Coleman said.

SCMB also said it had executed a co-financing agreement with the European Investment Bank for a loan facility of 80 million rand to be used mainly for the infrastructure projects in which the fund has an equity stake.
Loans pursuant to this agreement would be for terms of up to 15 years and would allow SCMB to access both fixed and variable funding.
SCMB said that these latest developments were timely as the fund was currently in the last stages of investigation on several projects.

Members of the fund also include Genbel Securities Ltd, Metropolitan Life Ltd, Public Investment Commissioners, SA Mutual Life Assurance Society, South African Eagle Insurance Co Ltd, Standard Bank of South Africa and Transnet Pension Fund.
